title: Saya jumpa Mario Kart di arked permainan di SM Clark
label: Arked Mal

text.The SM mall in the Philippines had an ar: Pusat beli-belah SM di Filipina ada arked permainan.
text.Compared to arcades in Japanese shopping: Berbanding arked di pusat beli-belah Jepun, keseluruhan arked itu terasa lebih neon, dan suasana lampunya berwarna ungu.
text.Also, inside the arcade, there were abou: Selain itu, di dalam arked, ada kira-kira 5 bilik karaoke, saiznya kira-kira untuk 2 orang, dan anda boleh nampak terus ke dalamnya dari luar.
text.Of course, there were also some Japanese: Sudah tentu, ada juga beberapa permainan Jepun.
text.They had a game where you shoot basketba: Mereka ada permainan menjaringkan bola keranjang, permainan syiling memancing Jepun, dan permainan zombi seperti Resident Evil.
text.And they also had Mario Kart!: Dan mereka juga ada Mario Kart!
text.Someone I knew in Clark often drove me t: Seorang kenalan di Clark sering memandu saya ke Koreatown di Angeles
